spec.description:
Kingspan
Kooltherm K15 Rainscreen Board is a premium performance, fiber-free rigid
thermoset phenolic insulation board engineered specifically for ventilated
rainscreen facade systems. Manufactured with a low-emissivity composite foil
facing, it achieves an ultra-low thermal conductivity of 0.021 W/m·K, allowing
modern building envelopes to meet ambitious thermal U-values with the thinnest
possible wall profile. Widely tested in large-scale facade fire tests (such as
BS 8414 / BR 135), it resists moisture penetration and provides structural
stability behind terracotta, metal cassette, and stone rainscreens.
features:
Ultra-thin rigid insulation engineered specifically for
ventilated rainscreen facade systems

Thermal conductivity as low as 0.021
W/m·K across all thicknesses ≥ 45mm

Low-emissivity composite foil facing
reflects radiant heat across the ventilated cavity

Extensive full-scale
facade fire testing to BS 8414-1 and BS 8414-2 classified to BR 135

Maximizes
internal floor space by significantly reducing external wall thickness

Closed-cell phenolic core resists moisture absorption and water ingress behind
claddings
Fiber-free, non-deleterious core, safe to handle on jobsites

Lightweight boards easy to transport, cut, and mechanically fix to backing
walls
Manufactured with zero ODP and low GWP blowing agents

technical.value:
Euroclass C-s1, d0 / Euroclass B-s1,
d0 (system dependent)

Successfully tested to BS 8414-1 and BS 8414-2; BR 135
compliant

spec.fire:
Reaction to fire Euroclass C-s1, d0 to EN 13501-1; System
performance evaluated in BS 8414-1 & BS 8414-2 tests achieving BR 135
classification
spec.sustainability:
Manufactured with a blowing agent that
has zero ODP and low GWP; fiber-free; low VOC
install:
Ensure structural
substrate (masonry, concrete, or steel framing with sheathing board) is plumb,
clean, and dry

Fasten boards mechanically to substrate with proprietary
insulation fasteners with minimum 70mm diameter heads

Install fasteners at a
minimum rate of 6 per board (1200x2400mm), located 50-100mm from corners and
edges
Stagger board joints in a brick-bond pattern, butting joints tightly

Fit cavity fire barriers horizontally and vertically as required by building
codes

Maintain the minimum specified ventilated cavity depth
(typically 38-50mm) between insulation foil face and outer cladding

Tape
joints with approved foil tape where enhanced weather protection is specified
selection_checklist:
Verify rainscreen cladding type (terracotta tile,
composite metal, high-pressure laminate, or stone)

Confirm target wall
U-value / R-value to determine required board thickness

Confirm local
building code fire compliance pathways for facade insulation

Select approved
mechanical fasteners suitable for substrate (concrete, steel stud, or cement
particle board)
accessories:
Mechanical rainscreen insulation fasteners
with 70mm heads
limitations:
Must not be left permanently exposed to external weathering;
outer rainscreen cladding must be installed

Ensure ventilated cavity between
board face and cladding remains unobstructed

Cavity barriers must be
installed at floor slab levels and compartment lines

meeting low U-values in slim
facade
use_cases:
Continuous exterior insulation behind ventilated rainscreen facades

High-performance thermal

Slim-profile external
wall insulation to maximize interior floor area in high-density urban
developments
